name: suspender single leg squat figure
description: A one-leg squat holding the straps for support, building leg strength and balance.
instructions: Hold the handles and stand on one leg, other leg forward.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee.
Lower as far as you can control.
Keep your knee over your toes and chest tall.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
